identity.real_world_identity_notes: Reiza's version of the Stadium Super Trucks, the stadium off-road series Robby Gordon created in 2013, carried in AMS2 under a changed name. Reiza describes the series as fictional, and this record previously took that to mean no real car stood behind it; the maintainer identified the real series. The series' own specification gives a two or three speed transmission depending on track configuration behind a 600 hp EFI V-8, and the drive found three ratios, so the count agrees. That source does not say whether the real transmission is automatic and does not name the unit, so the automatic behaviour and the self-blipping downshift remain the simulator's, observed rather than corroborated.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a closed round rim without integrated display or wheel-mounted shift lights.

notes: The gearbox shifts automatically but permits manual override through the visible sequential cockpit lever.
The vehicle moved from rest without physical clutch input and all three forward ratios were observed.
Automatic downshift blip was observed; automatic upshift cut remains unknown rather than inferred.

The three forward ratios agree with the series' own two-or-three-speed specification. Whether the real transmission is automatic is not established by that source, so the automatic shifting is recorded from the drive.
The automatic transmission shifted itself; the visible sequential lever provides a manual override and is the modeled physical selector.

confidence.basis: Exact fictional-series identity, automatic behavior, manual sequential-lever override, three ratios, automatic blip, and cockpit wheel were directly observed. Automatic cut remains unknown.

claims.basis: The series' own specification for the trucks it builds, matched to the exact live telemetry identity. AMS2 carries the series under a changed name, so the record names the real series rather than treating the renaming as a fictional car.
Guided current-game testing and cockpit inspection directly established the automatic behavior, manual lever override, ratios, blip, and wheel.
The test did not reliably establish whether the automatic transmission performs an observable throttle cut.

The series' own specification gives a two or three speed transmission depending on track configuration, and the drive found three ratios. The same source says nothing about how the gearbox is operated, so it backs the count alone.

driver_summary: It shifts itself. The sequential lever in the cockpit overrides the automatic box but is never required.
